targets.true_peak_method: 4x polyphase oversampling (scipy resample_poly), max of all channels
targets.loudness_method: ITU-R BS.1770-4 via pyloudnorm (integrated, gated); momentary = ungated 400 ms K-weighted windows, 10 ms hop

gains.note: master.wav = limiter(G * (voice dual-mono + music.wav/G + sfx.wav/G)); music.wav and sfx.wav are written post-gain (the level they have in master.wav, before the limiter)

analysis_before_ducking.tuning_method: per segment of 1.8 s or more: Hann FFT (5 s max, 4x zero padding), spectral peaks 120 to 2000 Hz within 24 dB of the strongest, grouped by nearest note, magnitude-weighted centre in cents (the pad's chorus spreads each note +-3.5 to 7 cents by design)

faded_at_end.note: tail faded to end by 89.95 s (natural end 90.417 s)

placed.note: tail faded to end by 89.95 s (natural end 90.417 s)
